Argentina pauses football matches to honor Lionel Messi

Football matches across Argentina were paused in the 10th minute to honor Lionel Messi following his recent announcement of retirement from international football. The tribute saw fans and stadiums erupt in applause for the celebrated player. This nationwide gesture acknowledges Messi's significant career and impact on the sport. The event highlights the deep admiration for Messi within Argentina.
